page_2.details:
Silhouette: Semi-fitted hip-length jacket with structured shoulders, defined waist suppression, and straight hem
Sleeves: Full-length set-in sleeves with braid trim finish at cuff edge
Other Features:
Collarless neckline with center front V-notch, open-front with no visible closure mechanism
Continuous two-tone braided chain trim applied to center front edges, neckline, hem, all pocket edges, and cuffs
Two upper chest flap patch pockets and two lower patch pockets, each with single decorative gold-tone embossed button

size_label.placement: Below or beside the brand label

care_label.placement: Inner left side seam, above 10–15 cm from the hem

page_3.label_notes: The color of the labels is white. Type of: 100% Recycled polyester woven label.

accessories.description: Gold Chain Trim — metallic chain-style decorative trim (not woven braid/gimp as originally described — visually confirmed as gold chain or chain-link style trim) — width approximately 10–12mm TBC per POM — pre-finished edges — sufficient yardage for all outer edges: CF left full length, CF right full length, full neckline circumference, full hem width, both cuffs, all four pocket panel perimeters, all three exposed edges of both upper pocket flaps, all three exposed edges of both lower pocket flaps
accessories.quantity_per_style: As required per pattern/marker — calculate total trim yardage across all listed positions
accessories.color: Gold / Gold-tone metallic — NOT navy. Trim is visually confirmed as gold chain trim contrasting against the navy shell fabric
accessories.position: Continuous application: center front left and right full length, full neckline circumference, full hem width, both cuff edges, all four pocket panel perimeters (upper and lower), all exposed edges of both upper pocket flaps, all exposed edges of both lower pocket flaps
accessories.justification: Clearly visible in both front and back images. Original AI entry contained two critical errors: (1) described as 'woven or gimp braid' — it is visibly a chain or chain-link style trim; (2) described color as 'Midnight Navy to match shell' — trim is clearly gold-tone, contrasting with the navy body fabric. Corrected accordingly.

accessories.description: Decorative Gold-Tone Buttons — shank or sew-through — diameter TBC (approx 15–18mm) — gold-tone metal finish with embossed or logo detail — one per pocket, four total — purely decorative, no functional closure role
accessories.quantity_per_style: 4 (one per pocket: two upper chest pockets, two lower patch pockets)
accessories.color: Gold-tone metallic — visually confirmed in front image
accessories.position: Centered on each of the four patch pocket flaps — two upper chest pockets and two lower patch pockets — placement per POM X and POM Y
accessories.justification: Four gold-tone decorative buttons clearly visible in front image, one on each pocket flap. Original AI entry listed qty as N/A and color as TBC — corrected to qty 4 and color gold-tone based on visual confirmation.

accessories.description: Care Label — woven or printed — full fiber composition and care instruction per applicable market regulations — US Women's market
accessories.color: White or ivory ground with navy or black print
accessories.position: Interior center back neckline — sewn inside back neckline facing or lining at center back neck
accessories.justification: Mandatory regulatory requirement for US market — not visible externally but structurally required on all finished garments.

accessories.description: Size Label — woven — US Women's sizing — XS / S / M / L / XL or equivalent brand sizing convention — may be combined with care label or attached adjacently
accessories.color: White or ivory ground with navy or black print
accessories.position: Interior center back neckline — adjacent to or combined with care label
accessories.justification: Mandatory labeling requirement — not visible externally but structurally required on all finished garments.

accessories.description: Sewing Thread — core-spun polyester or poly-wrapped cotton — matching threads required for shell construction (navy), chain trim attachment (gold or neutral), and button attachment (gold or neutral)
accessories.color: Midnight Navy for shell seams and structural stitching; Gold or neutral for trim topstitching and button attachment
accessories.position: All structural seams, lining attachment, trim application, button attachment throughout garment
accessories.justification: Mandatory construction component omitted entirely from original AI accessories list. Required for all seaming, trim attachment, and button sewing operations.

accessories.description: REMOVED — Center Front Closure Hardware (buttons or hook-and-eye): Originally listed as Item 3. Removed because the jacket is visually confirmed as an open-front style with no center front closure mechanism of any kind. No CF buttons, no hook-and-eye, and no placket are visible in either the front or back images.
accessories.justification: Hallucinated accessory. Front image clearly shows an open-front jacket with no closure hardware at center front. Both left and right CF panels are finished with chain trim only. No buttons, snaps, hooks, or placket details are present at CF.

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — pressed open, stay tape applied full length before joining, both allowances edge-finished separately
seams.justification: Structural shoulder seam for set-in sleeve. Stay tape applied before joining to prevent elongation under sleeve weight. Allowances pressed open for flat finish. Both allowances individually overlocked (504) after join to prevent gabardine fray at high-load zone.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — pressed open, stay tape applied full length before joining, both allowances edge-finished separately

seams.seam_type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked after lockstitch join
seams.justification: Gabardine frays readily at cut edges. Both shoulder seam allowances must be individually overlocked to prevent fray at one of the highest-load seam zones.
seams.type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked after lockstitch join

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — waist suppression shaping, curved seam, pressed using tailor's ham, allowances pressed open or to back per brand standard
seams.justification: Curved waist suppression seam requires precise notch alignment and tailor's ham pressing for correct shaping. Both allowances individually overlocked after join for fray prevention at curved waist suppression area.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — waist suppression shaping, curved seam, pressed using tailor's ham, allowances pressed open or to back per brand standard

seams.seam_type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked after join
seams.justification: Mandatory fray prevention at curved waist suppression area in gabardine. Both allowances finished individually after join.
seams.type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked after join

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — pressed flat, no decorative treatment. If single-panel back, finish interior edges only.
seams.justification: Stable structural seam if panel requires joining. Both allowances overlocked individually regardless of whether CB seam is structural or edge-only to prevent gabardine fray.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — pressed flat, no decorative treatment. If single-panel back, finish interior edges only.

seams.seam_type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked
seams.justification: Overlock finish on CB allowances to prevent fray regardless of whether CB seam is structural or edge-only.
seams.type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked

seams.part: Center Front Edge — Left and Right
seams.seam_type: Edge Finish — Faced — interfaced, faced, understitched to prevent roll. Braid trim applied continuously from V-notch to hem on both panels. Not a joining seam.
seams.justification: Open front edge must be fully interfaced and faced before braid trim attachment. Understitching prevents facing roll. Continuous braid trim runs full CF length from V-notch to hem on both panels. Stable edge preparation is mandatory.
seams.type: Edge Finish — Faced — interfaced, faced, understitched to prevent roll. Braid trim applied continuously from V-notch to hem on both panels. Not a joining seam.

seams.seam_type: Edge Finish — Faced — stay-stitched at V-notch apex (25mm radius), interfaced, faced, understitched. Braid must miter or pivot precisely at V-notch point.
seams.machine_type: Single Needle Lockstitch (SNLS) — Precision Needle Position
seams.justification: Collarless V-notch neckline carries continuous braid trim. V-notch apex is the highest-precision trim junction on the garment. Stay-stitch, interface, and face before braid application. Tight stitch length for precision control at apex miter point.
seams.type: Edge Finish — Faced — stay-stitched at V-notch apex (25mm radius), interfaced, faced, understitched. Braid must miter or pivot precisely at V-notch point.
seams.machine: Single Needle Lockstitch (SNLS) — Precision Needle Position

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — Reinforced — double-stitched within seam allowance, notched and clipped at curves, both allowances pressed toward sleeve. Sleeve cap ease distributed carefully — no gathering or forcing.
seams.justification: Highest stress seam zone on garment. Double-stitched for reinforcement. Gabardine resists ease — sleeve cap ease must be carefully distributed without gathering. Notch and clip curves before overlock pass. Both allowances pressed toward sleeve.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — Reinforced — double-stitched within seam allowance, notched and clipped at curves, both allowances pressed toward sleeve. Sleeve cap ease distributed carefully — no gathering or forcing.

seams.seam_type: Overlock Edge Finish — both sleeve cap and bodice armhole allowances overlocked together after double-stitch join. Curved seam clipping required before overlock pass.
seams.justification: Curved seam clipping required before overlock pass to prevent puckering at press. Both allowances overlocked together after double-stitch join.
seams.type: Overlock Edge Finish — both sleeve cap and bodice armhole allowances overlocked together after double-stitch join. Curved seam clipping required before overlock pass.

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — two-part sleeve construction, allowances pressed open. Back sleeve seam is explicitly visible in back view — must be pressed straight and even.
seams.justification: Visible back seam line requires particularly clean pressing after finish. Both allowances individually overlocked after join. Pressed open for flat back seam appearance.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — two-part sleeve construction, allowances pressed open. Back sleeve seam is explicitly visible in back view — must be pressed straight and even.

seams.seam_type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked
seams.justification: Visible back seam requires particularly clean pressing after overlock finish. Both allowances finished individually.
seams.type: Overlock Edge Finish — both allowances individually overlocked

seams.seam_type: Edge Finish — Interfaced Hem — hem edge turned up, stay-stitched, and stabilized. Braid trim applied continuously at cuff edge — must align with sleeve seam at cuff junction.
seams.justification: Interfaced before braid trim application. Braid trim at cuff must align precisely with sleeve seam at cuff junction. Stable, flat edge preparation mandatory for continuous braid trim integrity.
seams.type: Edge Finish — Interfaced Hem — hem edge turned up, stay-stitched, and stabilized. Braid trim applied continuously at cuff edge — must align with sleeve seam at cuff junction.

seams.part: Body Hem Edge — Full Garment Width
seams.seam_type: Edge Finish — Interfaced Hem — straight horizontal lower hem, interfaced, hem allowance pressed up and stabilized. Braid trim applied continuously — must align precisely at both lower front corners where CF braid meets hem braid.
seams.justification: Braid trim must align precisely at both lower front corners where CF braid meets hem braid. Interfaced before trim application. Highest hem allowance on garment to support flat braid trim junction.
seams.type: Edge Finish — Interfaced Hem — straight horizontal lower hem, interfaced, hem allowance pressed up and stabilized. Braid trim applied continuously — must align precisely at both lower front corners where CF braid meets hem braid.

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — Patch Pocket. Pocket panels fully constructed and braid-trimmed as sub-assemblies before shell attachment. Attached along three sides, top corners reinforced. Template-positioned.
seams.justification: Pocket panels must be fully braid-trimmed as sub-assemblies prior to shell attachment. Template positioning ensures left-right symmetry. Top corners reinforced with bar-tack or box-stitch after perimeter stitching.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — Patch Pocket. Pocket panels fully constructed and braid-trimmed as sub-assemblies before shell attachment. Attached along three sides, top corners reinforced. Template-positioned.

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — Patch Pocket. Same sub-assembly process as upper pockets. Attachment reinforced at upper corners with bar-tack or box-stitch. Template-positioned for left-right symmetry.
seams.justification: Sub-assembly braid-trim process identical to upper pockets. Template positioning critical for symmetry. Bar-tack or box-stitch at upper corners mandatory to prevent stress tear-out.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — Patch Pocket. Same sub-assembly process as upper pockets. Attachment reinforced at upper corners with bar-tack or box-stitch. Template-positioned for left-right symmetry.

seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — flap outer face and facing joined, turned, and pressed. Braid trim applied to all three exposed flap edges. Flap width must match lower pocket opening width exactly.
seams.justification: Flap width must match lower pocket opening exactly for braid trim continuity. Deviation creates trim gap or overlap at flap-to-pocket junction. Constructed as sub-assembly before attachment to shell.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — flap outer face and facing joined, turned, and pressed. Braid trim applied to all three exposed flap edges. Flap width must match lower pocket opening width exactly.

seams.part: Pocket Corner Reinforcement — All Four Pockets
seams.seam_type: Reinforcement — Bar-Tack or Box-Stitch at upper corners of all four pocket attachment points. Applied after pocket perimeter stitching.
seams.justification: Prevents stress tear-out at highest pull point on pocket. Applied after pocket perimeter stitching at all four pockets (upper ×2, lower ×2), upper corners only.
seams.type: Reinforcement — Bar-Tack or Box-Stitch at upper corners of all four pocket attachment points. Applied after pocket perimeter stitching.

seams.seam_type: Lapped Seam — Trim Attachment. Continuous braid trim stitched to all outer edges: center front (L+R), neckline, hem, cuffs, and all pocket perimeters. Applied with consistent tension using trim guide foot. Mitered or precisely pivoted at all corners and V-notch apex.
seams.stitch_type: Lockstitch (301) — Twin Needle at edges if required
seams.machine_type: Single Needle Lockstitch — Trim Guide / Braid Foot Attachment
seams.justification: Braid trim is the primary exterior design element running continuously across all outer edges. All base edges must be fully interfaced and faced before trim application. Miter or pivot precision at V-notch apex and all hem corners is critical to garment quality. Separate controlled assembly process after all interfacing is confirmed complete.
seams.type: Lapped Seam — Trim Attachment. Continuous braid trim stitched to all outer edges: center front (L+R), neckline, hem, cuffs, and all pocket perimeters. Applied with consistent tension using trim guide foot. Mitered or precisely pivoted at all corners and V-notch apex.
seams.machine: Single Needle Lockstitch — Trim Guide / Braid Foot Attachment

seams.part: Lining — Body Seams and Shell Attachment
seams.seam_type: Superimposed Seam — lining panels joined at shoulder and side seams, allowances pressed open. Lining attached to shell at neckline, center front facing, and hem edge — eased to allow interior movement without pulling.
seams.justification: Lining must be eased at all shell attachment points to prevent interior pull during wear. Slightly longer stitch length used for lining seams to allow slight give without seam failure. Lining must not be taut against shell.
seams.type: Superimposed Seam — lining panels joined at shoulder and side seams, allowances pressed open. Lining attached to shell at neckline, center front facing, and hem edge — eased to allow interior movement without pulling.

measurements.justification: All measurements converted from cm to inches. Half-body lay-flat measurements for: Chest Half 44.5±1.0cm, Waist Half 36.5±1.0cm, Hem Sweep Half 46.5±1.0cm, Shoulder 37.0±0.5cm, Sleeve Length 59.0±0.5cm, Back Length 57.5±0.5cm. Ranges reflect stated tolerances. Grade: -1.0cm per size from M base for circumference POMs, -1.0cm back length from M. Non-graded POMs (pockets, flaps, neck drop, braid trim) fixed across all sizes.

fabrics.description: Wool Gabardine — Structured Twill Weave — Slight Surface Sheen — High Opacity — No Stretch — Dimensional Stability Required
fabrics.finish: Slight sheen, consistent across all cut panels. No matte variants permitted on outer shell pieces.
fabrics.position: Full outer shell — front panels (L+R), back panel, sleeves (L+R), all pocket panels (upper flap pockets ×2, lower patch pockets ×2), pocket flaps ×2
fabrics.justification: Gabardine twill construction provides body and edge firmness required for set-in sleeve support, self-structured patch pockets, seam-only waist suppression, and flat stable edge preparation for continuous braid trim across all outer edges. 60/40 wool-polyester split delivers F/W seasonal weight, dimensional stability, reduced shrinkage, and Midnight Navy color retention.

fabrics.description: Cupro or Polyester Satin Lining — Smooth, low-friction interior surface — No stretch
fabrics.finish: Smooth satin-finish interior for ease of dressing over base layers.
fabrics.color: Midnight Navy (to match shell) or Ivory / Champagne — TBC by brand
fabrics.position: Full interior body lining — front panels, back panel. Sleeves fully or half-lined per brand standard. Lining must not extend to pocket panels or pocket flaps.
fabrics.justification: Protects gabardine shell from abrasion at collar back, armhole, and side seams; conceals seam allowances and interfacing from interior view; provides smooth interior hand for wear over base layers. Cupro preferred for breathability and drape compatibility with gabardine outer at F/W weight.

fabrics.description: Woven Fusible Interfacing — Medium Weight — One-sided fusible resin application — Woven construction only, no weft-insertion or stretch variants
fabrics.color: Charcoal / Navy (non-show-through behind Midnight Navy shell)
fabrics.position: Interior side of: center front edges (full length L+R), neckline edge (full circumference), hem edge (full width front-back), cuff hem edges (L+R sleeves), all pocket panel perimeters, all pocket flap panels — full face of flap
fabrics.justification: Primary risk-mitigation against edge rolling or waviness in gabardine before trim attachment, V-notch point distortion under trim tension, pocket edge distortion under braid trim weight and stitching tension, and hem corner lifting at braid trim junction points. All trim edges must be interfaced before trim application — mandatory pre-assembly step.

fabrics.description: Woven Stay Tape — Non-fusible or lightly fusible — Non-stretch — 10–12mm width
fabrics.position: (a) Shoulder seams — full length; (b) V-notch apex at center front neckline — radiating 25mm from apex; (c) Armhole seam — front and back bodice armhole edge
fabrics.justification: Shoulder stay tape prevents elongation under set-in sleeve weight. V-notch stay tape prevents the highest-precision trim junction from pulling open under wear or pressing. Armhole stay tape stabilizes the curved bodice armhole edge before sleeve cap attachment, preventing distortion in gabardine which resists ease.

quality_standards.comments: 60% Wool / 40% Polyester gabardine requires shrinkage control. Dimensional stability is explicitly mandatory given tight braid trim tolerances across all outer edges — any post-wash distortion would misalign trim and compromise silhouette.

Wool-blend structured outerwear at this quality tier is expected to require dry cleaning. Dimensional stability under dry cleaning conditions must be confirmed to protect structured shoulder line, waist suppression shaping, and braid trim alignment.
Midnight Navy is a deep, saturated dye on a wool-polyester woven. Color fastness to washing must be confirmed to prevent bleed or shade shift during laundering cycles.

As a wool-blend outerwear garment likely requiring dry cleaning, solvent fastness must be tested. Gold-tone braid trim adjacent to Midnight Navy fabric increases risk of solvent-induced dye migration onto trim.

quality_standards.test: Color Fastness to Rubbing (Dry and Wet)
quality_standards.comments: Midnight Navy is a dark, saturated color with high rub-staining risk. Gold-tone braid trim is in continuous contact with the fabric edges — wet and dry crocking onto the trim and onto adjacent surfaces must be controlled.
This is outerwear worn in daylight conditions. Midnight Navy is prone to UV fading and shade shift. Light fastness testing is required to confirm color durability over expected seasonal use.

quality_standards.test: Color Fastness to Perspiration (Acid and Alkaline)
quality_standards.comments: Womenswear jacket worn close to the body in areas of perspiration contact (underarm, inner sleeve, neckline). Dark navy dye on wool blend must not transfer under perspiration conditions.

Set-in sleeve armhole seam is the highest-stress zone in this jacket and must withstand arm movement and sleeve weight loads. Shoulder, side, and waist suppression seams also carry structural load in a semi-fitted silhouette. High QC strictness requires confirmed seam integrity across all structural zones.

Gabardine is sensitive to pressing distortion and seam puckering after laundering. Structured shoulder, waist suppression, and braid trim must retain their appearance after care treatment. Evaluated across shell fabric, pocket panels, and all trimmed edges.

60% wool content makes this fabric susceptible to surface pilling under friction. As outerwear worn with bags and arm movement, the outer shell is exposed to repeated surface abrasion. Pilling would be highly visible against the Midnight Navy ground and adjacent gold braid trim.

Structured woven outerwear garment subject to regular wear friction at elbows, cuffs, pocket edges, and underarm zones. Abrasion resistance must be confirmed to ensure the gabardine shell survives expected use cycles without thread breakdown or surface wear-through.

Gabardine is a smooth, tightly woven twill with a slight sheen finish. Smooth woven constructions are susceptible to seam slippage under lateral stress at side seams and waist shaping seams. Relevant given the semi-fitted silhouette and high QC strictness.

quality_standards.method: EN 71-1 Pull Force Method (Adult Apparel Adaptation) / Buyer Pull Test ≥ 50 N
quality_standards.requirements: Min. 50 N pull force sustained for 10 seconds without detachment
quality_standards.comments: Four decorative embossed logo buttons are applied to pocket flaps and lower pockets. Buttons must withstand pull force without detachment or shank failure. Precise placement is a defined design feature — button security is required to maintain both function and aesthetic integrity at High QC strictness.

quality_standards.requirements: Min. 40 N before trim separation or delamination
quality_standards.comments: Continuous braid trim is applied across all outer edges — center front, neckline, hem, cuffs, and all four pocket perimeters. Trim attachment is a primary structural and aesthetic feature of this garment. Bond strength must be confirmed to prevent trim lifting, separation, or edge distortion under wear and care.

quality_standards.requirements: ≥ 8 N/cm (dry), ≥ 6 N/cm (after washing or dry cleaning)
quality_standards.comments: Interfacing is applied to all braid-trimmed edges (center front, neckline, hem, cuffs, pocket panels) and is critical to edge stability beneath the trim. Interlining delamination after care would directly distort trimmed edges and cause braid misalignment. Bond strength must be confirmed pre- and post-care.

size_chart.pom: H — Sleeve Length (Shoulder Seam to Cuff Edge)
L — Front Neck Drop (HPS to V-Notch Point)
M — Back Neck Drop (HPS to Back Neckline Center)
U — Pocket Placement from HPS (Upper Pocket)
V — Pocket Placement from Center Front (Upper Pocket)
W — Pocket Placement from HPS (Lower Pocket)
Y — Button Placement Distance from HPS (Top Button)

wash_label.composition: Shell: 60% Wool / 40% Polyester | Lining: 100% Cupro (or 100% Polyester — TBC)
wash_label.washing_instructions: Dry Clean Only. Do not machine wash. Do not hand wash.
wash_label.drying_instructions: Do not tumble dry. Do not wring. Lay flat or hang to dry away from direct heat and sunlight if wet.
wash_label.ironing_instructions: Iron on low-medium heat with pressing cloth or steam iron at wool setting. Do not iron directly on braid trim or outer surface without pressing cloth. Press seams using tailor's ham.

dry_cleaning.line_2: Professional dry cleaning recommended. Short cycle. Inform cleaner of wool gabardine construction and braid trim detail.

standards: ASTM D5489 — Standard Guide for Care Symbols for Care Instructions on Textile Products (US Market)
ASTM D3512 — Pilling Resistance (reference for gabardine surface durability)
ISO 3175 — Professional Textile Care / Dry Cleaning (reference standard)
FTC Care Labeling Rule (16 CFR Part 423) — US Federal Trade Commission Care Labeling of Textile Wearing Apparel
wash_label.justification: Shell is 60% Wool / 40% Polyester gabardine at 220–270 GSM. Wool content requires dry clean only designation to prevent shrinkage, felting, and dimensional distortion. Machine washing not permitted. Lining composition (Cupro or Polyester TBC) is compatible with dry clean instructions. Braid trim must be protected during any pressing — pressing cloth mandatory. Care label composition line to be finalized once lining fiber content is confirmed by brand.

care_label_instructions: The care label must contain carelabel symbols and those only.
Care label must be made in recycled polyester.
Care labels must contain origin: made in India.
Care labels must be given the same size, font and style.

other_standards.title: Standard 100 by Oekotex
other_standards.description: Label that ensures consumers that all materials used in a garment are tested for harmful substances.

other_standards.title: EU Ecolabel
other_standards.description: Label that ensures consumers that textiles are made using less harmful substances, energy and water.

other_standards.title: Bluesign
other_standards.description: The Bluesign System reduces impact on people and the environment in the entire textile supply chain, based on input stream management.
